title: Final Evidence Manifest
description: Instance schema for the candidate-bound final evidence manifest (artifacts/release/0.9.2/final-evidence-manifest.json). Top-level run_status is derived: every blocking=true entry must be pass, no blocking entry may be pending, every policy-allowed skip must carry a justification and policy_reference, candidate SHA and schema digests must match, and no accepted residual-risk record may convert a P0/P1 blocking failure into a pass.

candidate_sha.description: Frozen release candidate source SHA; must equal artifacts/release/0.9.2/release-candidate-sha-manifest.json candidate_sha.

evidence_schema_digest.description: sha256 of the canonical serialization of schemas/final-evidence-manifest.schema.json.

observation_schema_digest.description: sha256 of the canonical serialization of schemas/observation-state.schema.json.

entries.description: One evidence entry per qualifying domain; the blocking-entry rule applies per entry.

run_status.description: Derived: pass only when every blocking=true entry is pass, no blocking entry is pending, every skip is policy-allowed and justified, and candidate SHA/schema digests match.

residual_risk.description: Accepted residual-risk records. A record may not convert a P0/P1 blocking failure into a pass.

artifact_ref.description: Immutable artifact path or retrieval ID for the evidence record.

justification.description: Required when status=skip: why the policy allows the skip.

policy_reference.description: Required when status=skip: policy rule that allows the skip.
